description: System definition for signal classification vocabulary. Declares the canonical taxonomy for all ingested data.

content.purpose: Universal data classification. Every piece of data entering Enki through the ingestion pipeline receives a signal_type from this vocabulary. The type determines how the data is parsed, what observables are extracted, and how it can be correlated.
content.extensibility: New signal types added via Tier 1 vocabulary extension (Gate A only). The LDU-P playground proposes new types when unrecognized data arrives.
content.governance: Signal types are ceremony-governed vocabulary. No schema drift. No rogue definitions.
